package openai // import "github.com/mrsibe/goat/ai/openai"

Package openai adapts OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses APIs to the ai model
interface.

TYPES

type CompletionsProvider struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    CompletionsProvider implements ai.Model using Chat Completions streaming.

func New(config Config) (*CompletionsProvider, error)
    New creates a Chat Completions provider. It is equivalent to NewCompletions
    and preserves the original GOAT entry point.

func NewCompletions(config Config) (*CompletionsProvider, error)
    NewCompletions creates an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions provider.

func (p *CompletionsProvider) Info() ai.ModelInfo

func (p *CompletionsProvider) Stream(ctx context.Context, request ai.Request) (ai.Stream, error)

type Config struct {
	APIKey           string
	BaseURL          string
	Model            string
	Provider         string
	Headers          map[string]string
	Query            map[string]string
	ReasoningFormat  ReasoningFormat
	SupportsThinking bool
	// DisableEnvAuth prevents the SDK from reading OPENAI_API_KEY from the
	// environment. Adapters that authenticate with another header use this to
	// avoid sending an unrelated Authorization header.
	DisableEnvAuth  bool
	HTTPClient      *http.Client
	MaxRetries      *int
	ContextWindow   int
	MaxOutputTokens int
}
    Config configures an OpenAI-compatible model. APIKey may be empty for local
    servers that do not require authentication.

type Provider = CompletionsProvider
    Provider is the original name for a Chat Completions model. New code should
    use CompletionsProvider or ResponsesProvider explicitly.

type ReasoningFormat string
    ReasoningFormat selects the request and replay wire format used by
    OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints.

const (
	// ReasoningFormatOpenAI uses the standard top-level reasoning_effort field.
	ReasoningFormatOpenAI ReasoningFormat = "openai"
	// ReasoningFormatDeepSeek uses DeepSeek's thinking object and
	// reasoning_content replay field.
	ReasoningFormatDeepSeek ReasoningFormat = "deepseek"
	// ReasoningFormatOpenRouter uses OpenRouter's nested reasoning object and
	// reasoning_details replay metadata.
	ReasoningFormatOpenRouter ReasoningFormat = "openrouter"
)
type ResponsesProvider struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    ResponsesProvider implements ai.Model using the OpenAI Responses API.

func NewResponses(config Config) (*ResponsesProvider, error)
    NewResponses creates an OpenAI Responses provider.

func (p *ResponsesProvider) Info() ai.ModelInfo

func (p *ResponsesProvider) Stream(ctx context.Context, request ai.Request) (ai.Stream, error)
